### Website or app

React App with a component that re-renders frequently

### Repro steps

**Note:** This is more like an accessibility and usability issue rather than a bug.
1. Open React DevTools Profiler
2. Profile an application with a component that re-renders frequently
3. Select a fiber with many render timestamps / commits
4. Scroll through the commit list to inspect individual renders
5. Observe that the WhatChanged section scrolls out of view
---
You may check the [recording here](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/114039848/576060298-05f2889a-4e0d-4464-965a-2821c63c2d30.mov?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJnaXRodWIuY29tIiwiYXVkIjoicmF3LmdpdGh1YnVzZXJjb250ZW50LmNvbSIsImtleSI6ImtleTUiLCJleHAiOjE3Nzk0MTMxMTEsIm5iZiI6MTc3OTQxMjgxMSwicGF0aCI6Ii8xMTQwMzk4NDgvNTc2MDYwMjk4LTA1ZjI4ODlhLTRlMGQtNDQ2NC05NjVhLTI4MjFjNjNjMmQzMC5tb3Y_.Nh2Tn_r40rIfqoBWtMsJiVNegHEcPfx1d4ZcnQ2S0h8).
